firstPlayerRule: Whoever most recently saw a sheep plays Wilson in the first round. Wilson makes the first swapping move; the person on their left makes Shep's first move.
houseFallback: If this criterion does not suit your group, agree to choose randomly. This is a house rule.
clarifications: Wilson first hides their tile while the others close their eyes. The remaining players cooperate as Shep; later Shep moves pass clockwise.
